title: Wall Framing Layout — Rough Carpentry and Framing
body:
Wall Framing Layout. This record belongs to the Rough Carpentry and Framing database and covers wall framing layout in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers framing layouts, stud, joist and rafter work, bracing and structural carpentry practice.

Actual content. Wall Framing Layout is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it. A complete wall framing layout entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.

This record belongs to the Rough Carpentry and Framing database and covers roof framing layout in full working detail: what it is, when it applies, how it is set out, and how it is checked. The database as a whole covers framing layouts, stud, joist and rafter work, bracing and structural carpentry practice.

Actual content. Roof Framing Layout is executed as follows. First, confirm the building type, the project stage and the governing requirements for the jurisdiction, and record those decisions before any dimension or quantity is fixed. Second, lay out the work from the controlling dimensions, keeping clearances, tolerances and interfaces with adjoining work explicit rather than assumed. Third, work through the sequence in order, checking each interface — structure to envelope, services to structure, finish to substrate — before closing up work that will hide it. Fourth, record the as-built result, including any deviation from the plan and the reason for it, so the next trade and the next inspection can rely on the record. A complete roof framing layout entry therefore carries its dimensions, its materials, its sequence, its tolerances and its check results, not a title alone.
